Kratom Sales Linked to Student Deaths: Clerk and Son Charged

A shop clerk and his son have been charged by federal prosecutors with selling illegal kratom, which is being investigated for its potential connection to the deaths of two University of Mississippi students. The charges stem from an ongoing probe into the students' deaths.
